statement0:
The word "faster" is mentioned in 2.6% of papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "faster" , 26.5% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This rate is similar to median Psychology paper (shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "faster" are in the bottom 44th percentile of fragile p-value percentages. Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "faster" tend to be published in lower impact factor journals (2nd percentile among all words) and tend to be cited less (2nd percentile word). In general, this word is positively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are more likely to publish papers containing "faster" (66th percentile).
